sections.title: Cartoon time — Happy Double Ninth Festival

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It is the Double Ninth Festival today.
lines.chinese: 今天是重阳节。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Do you know the Double Ninth Festival, Tina?
lines.chinese: Tina，你知道重阳节吗？

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: Yes, it's a day for old people. It's on the ninth day of the ninth lunar month.
lines.chinese: 知道，它是老年人的节日，在农历九月初九。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: What do people do on this day?
lines.chinese: 人们在这一天做些什么？

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: They show their love for their grandmothers and grandfathers. They give them gifts and do chores for them.
lines.chinese: 他们表达对祖父母的爱，给长辈送礼物，帮长辈做家务。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: What should we do for Grandpa?
lines.chinese: 我们应该为爷爷做些什么？

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: We can cook dinner for him.
lines.chinese: 我们可以为他做晚饭。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Good idea! We can make a card for him too.
lines.chinese: 好主意！我们还可以为他做一张卡片。

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: Great!
lines.chinese: 太好了！

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Bobby, Tina and their parents go to see Grandpa in the afternoon.
lines.chinese: 下午，Bobby、Tina和爸爸妈妈一起去看望爷爷。

lines.speaker: Bobby & Tina
lines.english: Happy Double Ninth Festival, Grandpa! We love you!
lines.chinese: 爷爷，重阳节快乐！我们爱你！

lines.speaker: Grandpa
lines.english: Thank you! I love you too!
lines.chinese: 谢谢你们！我也爱你们！

lines.speaker: Bobby's father
lines.english: My birthday is next Monday. I can't wait!
lines.chinese: 我的生日在下周一。我都等不及了！（爸爸的心里话）

sections.title: Sounds in focus — 字母组合 er 的发音 /ə/

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: I bought some flowers for my mother
lines.chinese: 我给妈妈买了一些花，

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: And put them in some water.
lines.chinese: 把它们放在水里。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: I made her a card and wrote on it:
lines.chinese: 我给她做了一张卡片，在上面写道：

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: "With love, from your daughter".
lines.chinese: “爱你的女儿”。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: Yesterday was 21st October.
lines.chinese: 昨天是10月21日。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: It was Grandma's 66th birthday.
lines.chinese: 那天是奶奶的66岁生日。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: We went to my grandparents' house in the morning.
lines.chinese: 我们上午去了爷爷奶奶家。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: My parents gave Grandma a nice smartphone.
lines.chinese: 爸爸妈妈送给奶奶一部漂亮的智能手机。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: I drew a picture for her.
lines.chinese: 我为她画了一幅画。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: We also brought a cake.
lines.chinese: 我们还带来了一个蛋糕。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: Grandpa and Grandma were so happy to see us.
lines.chinese: 爷爷奶奶见到我们非常高兴。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: We had a big lunch.
lines.chinese: 我们吃了一顿丰盛的午饭。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: We ate noodles and wished Grandma a long life.
lines.chinese: 我们吃了面条，祝奶奶长寿。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: Then Grandma blew out the candles, and we ate the cake.
lines.chinese: 然后奶奶吹灭蜡烛，我们吃了蛋糕。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: In the afternoon, I chatted with Grandma.
lines.chinese: 下午，我和奶奶聊天。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: We also took a family photo together.
lines.chinese: 我们还一起拍了一张全家福。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: We do this on Grandma's birthday every year.
lines.chinese: 我们每年都在奶奶生日时这样做。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: This is our 12th photo.
lines.chinese: 这是我们的第12张照片。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: Time flies!
lines.chinese: 时光飞逝！

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: When I was a little kid, Grandpa and Grandma took care of me.
lines.chinese: 我小时候，爷爷奶奶照顾我。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: Now I am a big boy.
lines.chinese: 现在我是个大男孩了。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: I can take care of them.
lines.chinese: 我可以照顾他们。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: I want to spend more time with them.
lines.chinese: 我想花更多时间陪伴他们。
